text:
Maya: Quick plan — mini launch nurture for trial users who hit /billing but didn't upgrade. 3-touch drip + webinar invite. Sync?
Tom: love it. quick cadence idea?
Maya: Day 0 welcome + value props, Day 3 use-case+tips, Day 7 benchmark invite (webinar). Segments: active-trial, dormant-trial, power-trial (>10 API calls).
Evelyn: Subject line brainstorm: `Get more from Redwood — trial tips`, `How to cut inference cost by 2x`, `Quick wins with your trial`
Tom: recommend A/B subject + CTA. send-window test: 09:00 local vs 14:00 local. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya: yep — A = subject variant, B = CTA variant (“Start optimization” vs “See benchmark”). tracking: utm_campaign=mini_launch_v1, utm_source=email
Ravi: need suppressions: no emails in last 7 days and exclude enterprise-managed accounts. can ops add?
Tom: I’ll make the HubSpot segment `mini-launch-trial-eligible` and add suppressions. ETA today.
Evan: creative/UX check — will review copy and hero image by EOD tomorrow. cc @Maya
Evelyn: will draft three email bodies tonight. quick copy ask: include one short customer stat and 2 CTAs (primary + secondary).
Maya: metric goals: open > 25%, click>6%, click->activation conv 3% (target +3% vs control).
Tom: schedule proposal: final QA Tue 2026-03-31, send Wed 2026-04-01 in APAC first, then NA/EU staggered over 24h.
Maya: approvals: marketing sign-off + legal quick check on customer stat. Ravi can you handle legal tick?
Ravi: I’ll ping legal. also we need unsubscribe snippet + privacy footer aligned to policy.
SendBot: schedule job created (job_id: sj_2026_179333). Final QA reminder set for 1793242400 (24h before send). Will run suppression sync 2h before job.
Evelyn: quick sample subject + preview text pair: `How Redwood cut inference cost — 3 quick tips` / `Small changes. Big savings.` Thoughts?
Tom: thumbs up from me. A/B cell sizes: 10% each for subject and CTA, 80% holdout for main flow? maybe 50/50 for simpler test.
Maya: keep it simple — subject A/B 20% split, rest default. Good to go. I'll upload templates to /marketing/campaigns/mini-launch and share links.
Evan: will confirm hero asset size and provide final image by EOD Mon.
Maya: thanks — let's reconvene after QA. :thumbsup:
